# KTH Obsidian Study Vault

> Personal study vault for a KTH (Kungliga Tekniska Högskolan) student on the
> "Högskoleingenjör – Teknik och Ekonomi" programme (computer/IT engineering with
> an economics track). It contains ~500+ interconnected Markdown notes covering
> university coursework across multiple terms. **The note content is written in
> Swedish**; technical terms are often English. Unless asked otherwise, respond
> in Swedish when answering questions about this material.

This file is an entry point for AI tools (NotebookLM, ChatGPT/Claude Projects, RAG
pipelines, Kiro, etc.). It explains how the vault is organized and how to correctly
interpret the Obsidian-specific syntax inside the notes.

## How the vault is organized

- `KTH/` — All coursework, grouped by term then course:
  `KTH/<Year Season>/<CourseCode CourseName>/<Category>/<note>.md`
  - `<Year Season>` uses Swedish seasons: `Vår` (spring) and `Höst` (autumn),
    e.g. `2025 Höst`, `2026 Vår`.
  - `<Category>` is exactly one of these four, and **all four exist in every course**
    (empty ones included, for uniformity):
    - `Begrepp` — concept/definition notes (one concept per note, often with flashcards)
    - `Föreläsningar` — all dated session notes: lectures, lessons and exercises.
      The `föreläsning` / `lektion` / `övning` tag distinguishes them, not the folder.
      Filenames follow `YYYY-MM-DD - CODE - Type`.
    - `Anteckningar` — general notes, study guides, exam-prep question sets, labs,
      projects, meeting protocols
    - `Filer` — attachments only (PDF, PNG, Excalidraw). `Filer/Litteraturlista/`
      holds course literature plus any generated `.opt.md` / `.ai.md` book
      conversions and conversion tooling docs. **Not authored study notes — skip
      these when reading for meaning.**
  - Every course folder also contains `_index.md` at its root: a generated,
    Dataview-driven overview of that course's notes. Best per-course entry point.
- `Atlas/` — "Maps of Content" (MOCs): curated hub notes that link out to
  related notes by subject, plus a `Dashboard.md`. Good starting points for
  understanding a topic area.
- `Meta/` — Obsidian tooling: note `Templates`, plugin notes, Excalidraw drawings.
  Not study content.
- `Ericsson/` — Work/internship notes, separate from studies (currently empty;
  out of scope for study content).
- `KTH/Generella Anteckningar KTH.md` — General cross-course links/resources.
- `KTH/Kurs Mapp Mall/` — An empty template folder for new courses. Ignore for content.
- `index.md`, `README.md` — Vault landing/navigation notes.
- `.obsidian/`, `.trash/`, `.gitignore`, `package-lock.json` — App config and
  housekeeping. **Not content — ignore when reading for meaning.**

## Tag taxonomy (in YAML frontmatter)

Most notes begin with a frontmatter block like `tags: [begrepp, HI1027, programmering, KTH, year2025]`,
plus ISO `created:` / `updated:` dates. Tags fall into four groups:

- Note type: `begrepp` (concept), `föreläsning`/`lektion` (lecture/lesson),
  `övning` (exercise), `labb` (lab), `seminarium` (seminar), `studieguide` (study
  guide), `tenta` (exam prep), `övrigt` (misc), `index`/`MOC` (hub notes).
- Subject: `programmering`, `nätverk`, `matematik`, `ekonomi`, `hårdvara`,
  `databaser`, `samhälle`, `säkerhet`.
- Course code: e.g. `HI1027`, `CM1005`, `HH1802`, `HE1026` (see catalog below).
- Year: `year2024`, `year2025`, `year2026`. Plus the umbrella tag `KTH`.

Course codes and well-known acronyms (`KTH`, `MOC`) are always UPPERCASE; every
descriptive tag is lowercase. See `Meta/Vault Standard.md` for the full rules.

## How to read Obsidian-specific syntax (important for AI)

When reading raw Markdown, ignore or reinterpret these artifacts — they are tooling
metadata, not prose:

- `<!--SR:!2025-10-21,5,248...-->` — Spaced-repetition scheduler data (review dates
  and SM-2 intervals). **Ignore for comprehension. Do not treat as content, and never
  delete it — it drives an active study-review schedule.**
- Flashcard delimiters, all meaning "term/question → definition/answer":
  - `Term(Definition):: answer` and `Term(Definition);; answer` — the text before
    `::`/`;;` is the term/question, the text after is the definition/answer.
  - `Question ??` / `Question ||` followed by lines — a Q&A flashcard; the text after
    the `??`/`||` is the answer.
- `` `= dateformat(this.file.ctime, ...)` `` and fenced ```` ```dataview ```` blocks —
  Dataview dynamic queries/fields. These render live in Obsidian; as raw text they are
  **not meaningful content — ignore them.**
- `==highlighted text==` — a highlighted key point (author emphasis).
- `[[Note Title]]` or `[[path/to/Note|Alias]]` — internal wiki-links to other notes.
  The link target is another note's title in this vault.
- `![[image.png]]` / `![[Some Note]]` — embedded attachment or transcluded note.
- `$inline$` and `$$block$$` — LaTeX math.

## Subject Maps of Content (start here for topic overviews)

- `Atlas/Programmering MOC.md` — Programming, software architecture, algorithms
- `Atlas/Nätverk MOC.md` — Networking, protocols
- `Atlas/Matematik MOC.md` — Mathematics
- `Atlas/Ekonomi MOC.md` — Economics / accounting / finance
- `Atlas/Hårdvara MOC.md` — Hardware / digital electronics
- `Atlas/Databaser MOC.md` — Databases
- `Atlas/Samhälle MOC.md` — Society / sustainability
- `Atlas/Dashboard.md` — Live dashboard (Dataview-driven)

- 2024 Höst: `HI1024` Programmering grundkurs · `HF1005` Informationsteknik och
  ingenjörsmetodik · `HF1006` Linjär algebra och analys · `HE1026` Digitalteknik
- 2024 Vår: `ME1003` Industriell Ekonomi · `CM1005` Extern Redovisning ·
  `HU1801` Industriell Marknadsföring · `HH1802` Finansiering och Organisationsteori
- 2025 Vår: `HF1201` Hållbar Utveckling och Ergonomi · `CM1008` Projektkurs i
  Applikationsutveckling · `HI1025` Operativsystem · `HE1028` Mikrodatorteknik
- 2025 Höst: `SF1686` Flervariabelanalys · `CM1000` Diskret Matematik ·
  `HI1030` Databasteknik · `HI1027` Objektorienterad Programmering
- 2026 Vår: `HF1012` Matematisk Statistik · `HI1039` Projektkurs ·
  `HE1033` Kommunikationsnät · `HI1029` Algoritmer och Datastrukturer
- 2026 Höst: `HI2002` Routing i IP-nät · `EN2720` Etisk hackning ·
  `HI1032` Kommunikationssystem · `HI1031` Distribuerade informationssystem

## Suggested reading order for an AI

1. Read this file, then `Atlas/Dashboard.md` and the relevant subject MOC(s).
2. For a course, read its `Begrepp` notes (definitions) before `Föreläsningar`
   (lectures) and `Anteckningar` (study guides / exam questions).
3. Use frontmatter tags to filter by course code, subject, or note type.
